body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Everyone Can Become Picasso!
Live Portrait Demo with Finger-Painting Artist at Showstoppers CES

Ambient Design www.artrage.com, the leading award-winning creator of realistic art painting software for Mac & Windows, announced today at the Consumer Electronics Show (CES) in Las Vegas that the ArtRage Studio Pro professional artist software is now available in touch-screen computers, including the all-new MSI multi-touch Wind Top AE series to be announced at CES. ArtRage users can draw directly on the MSI touch screen to simulate watercolor or oil painting. The Wind Top AE Series shows even more realistic ArtRage painting colors, with the color quality of red, yellow and blue as close to that of real paint as possible.
World-Renown Artist David Kassan Demos ArtRage at Showstoppers

In addition, at CES, ArtRage will also showcase other touch-screen computer manufacturers bundled with ArtRage at the Showstoppers CES event, held at the Wynn Hotel on January 6, 2011. Artist David Kassan will be on hand displaying his artistic finger-painting technique using ArtRage on iPad and touchscreen computers painting on-the-spot with models.
Special ArtRage for iPad Discounts During CES - Only $1.99 from Jan 6-9 – Bring ArtRage for iPad with You Everywhere You Go

During CES (from January 6 - January 9, 2011), ArtRage for iPad will be available at a discounted rate of only $1.99 (normally $6.99) at the Apple iTunes Store. ArtRage lets you become a mobile digital artist, providing the experience of actually "painting" digitally on a computer canvas with oil painting effects that smear and blend and watercolor strokes that merge to create soft, wet gradations, just as they would in a traditional art studio. An ArtRage-enabled iPad, tablet, or touch-screen laptop allows artists of all levels to bring their computer everywhere they go to be ready to spontaneously unleash their creativity on the spot by drawing, sketching, and painting in a wide range of artistic styles with tools that interact on the screen just as they would with real paint, ink, chalk, pen, or pencil.

ArtRage for iPad is available immediately, priced at $1.99 for a limited time (normal pricing is $6.99) at the iTunes store at: http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/artrage/id391432693?mt=8. The desktop versions of ArtRage for Mac & Windows are also available with more features, priced at $40 and $80 for ArtRage 3 Studio and ArtRage 3 Studio Pro respectively (see comparison chart at: http://www2.ambientdesign.com/files/artrage_product_comparison.pdf). For more information, see www.artrage.com.

Ambient Design Ltd. is a New Zealand-based global software development and publishing firm, specializing in creative applications and user interfaces for artists of all ages and all levels of competency, including professionals, hobbyists and students. The principals have over 40 years experience in combining complex image processing algorithms with an easily accessible user experience. Ambient Design Ltd. was founded in 2000 by Andy Bearsley and Matt Fox-Wilson, formerly of MetaCreations, the developer of Painter, Bryce and Kai's Power Tools. Ambient Design's products are available in 12 languages and have been downloaded over 10 million times. For more information, see www.artrage.com.
